headlines.description: The Indianapolis Colts became the latest team to hammer the Jacksonville Jaguars at home, winning 27-10 on Thursday night behind two rushing touchdowns from rookie quarterback Andrew Luck.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck runs in 2 TDs, leads Colts to 4th win in row

events.name: New York Giants at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: Andy Dalton threw a career-high four touchdown passes -- each to a different receiver -- and the Cincinnati Bengals ended their four-game losing streak by beating the New York Giants 31-13 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton throws 4 TDs as Bengals drub Giants

headlines.description: Colin McCarthy returned an interception 49 yards for a touchdown, and four takeaways helped the Tennessee Titans beat the Miami Dolphins 37-3 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Titans use 4 takeaways to trounce Dolphins

headlines.description: Adrian Peterson raced 61 yards for the game-sealing touchdown midway through the fourth quarter, padding his NFL rushing lead with 171 yards on 27 carries for the Minnesota Vikings in a 34-24 victory over the Detroit Lions on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peterson trucks to 171 yards, TD as Vikings roll

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw for two touchdowns, Devin McCourty ended Buffalo's hopes with an interception in the end zone, and the New England Patriots kept the surprisingly tough Bills winless at Gillette Stadium with a 37-31 victory on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pats hang on, move to 11-0 vs. Bills at Gillette

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Jimmy Graham caught seven passes for a career-best 146 yards and two touchdowns, cornerback Jabari Greer made a diving, touchdown-saving pass breakup on a late fourth-down play, and the Saints held on to hand the Falcons their first loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Falcons upended by Saints in 1st loss of season

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Josh Freeman threw two touchdown passes and the surging Buccaneers scored on a blocked punt and Leonard Johnson's 83-yard interception return to beat the Chargers 34-24 for their third straight win Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Surging Bucs top Chargers to win 3rd in a row

headlines.description: Peyton Manning made sure John Fox's return to Carolina was a successful one, throwing for 301 yards and a touchdown to lead the Denver Broncos to a 36-14 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning helps Fox to win in Carolina return

headlines.description: Joe Flacco threw for 341 yards and three touchdowns, and the Baltimore Ravens set a club record for points in a 55-20 rout of the Oakland Raiders on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens set club mark, score 55 vs. Raiders

events.name: New York Jets at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw touchdowns of 38 yards to Golden Tate and 31 yards to Sidney Rice, and the sent the New York Jets to their worst start since 2007 with a 28-7 win on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks send Jets to worst start since 2007

headlines.description: Tony Romo threw a pair of touchdowns, Dwayne Harris had a 78-yard punt return for a score and Brandon Carr returned an interception 47 yards for a TD to lead the Cowboys to a 38-23 win over the Eagles.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys knock out Vick, beat sliding Eagles

events.name: St. Louis Rams at San Francisco 49ers

headlines.description: The St. Louis Rams and San Francisco 49ers played the NFL's first tie game in four years as both team's kickers missed overtime field goals Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rams, Niners play to NFL's 1st tie since 2008

headlines.description: Arian Foster finished with 102 yards rushing and a touchdown catch, and the Texans intercepted Jay Cutler twice before knocking him out of the game with a concussion on their way to a 13-6 victory over the Bears on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans knock out Cutler, shut down Bears

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: The Steelers edged the woeful Kansas City Chiefs 16-13 in overtime on Monday night but lost Ben Roethlisberger for most of the second half -- and perhaps a lot longer -- with a right shoulder injury.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers lose Roethlisberger in win over Chiefs
